name: tradingagents-portable
description: Run TradingAgents research with the current host task and inspect the completed read-only dossier.

interface.shortDescription: Use host agents to build a final research dossier.
interface.longDescription: A credential-free research capability where the current Codex task or another host harness executes the complete TradingAgents topology with its own agents and tools, then atomically imports a validated result into a read-only dossier.
defaultPrompt: Research ORCL with this Codex task using the host-native workflow; do not request API keys.
Research any supported instrument with the current host's own agents and tools.
Inspect a completed run through the merged read-only dossier.
